about_page.label: About Gyanoday AI:
about_page.headline: For Every Student, A Personal AI Learning Guide
about_page.paragraph1: Gyanoday AI is a smart digital learning platform designed to support students at every step of their learning journey. Our goal is to make education simple, clear, and stress-free.
about_page.paragraph2: Instead of just providing study material, Gyanoday AI helps students follow a structured learning path with the right guidance, practice, and AI-powered support—so they can learn better and grow confidently.

faq_page.subtext: Find answers to all your questions about Gyanoday AI here. We are here to make your learning journey simple and effective.

questions.question: How this work?
questions.answer: Gyanoday AI follows a structured path. You start with a concept, practice with AI guidance, and then take a quiz to test your knowledge.

questions.question: Are there any additional fee?
questions.answer: No, there are no hidden or additional fees. The price you see is what you pay for the entire course duration.

questions.question: What features do you offer and other not?
questions.answer: We offer personalized AI tutoring, step-by-step lessons, PDF notes, and interactive quizzes. We focus on concept clarity and confidence building.
